segments.he: א' מאנ"ש אמר פעם להאיש שהי' לומד ברבים תנו לו תורה כזו שאוכל ליקח אותו לכיסו לכם ולילך אחר לשוק "גיט ?? אזא תורה איך זמל קמין מארגין זיין מיט איהר אין גאס:
segments.en: One of our fellowship in Breslov experienced a bereavement, G-d preserve us, a few days before Rosh HaShanah. He sent a question to the rabbi of Breslov — the holy Tzaddik Reb Tzvi Aryeh, son of Reb Aharon the rabbi of Breslov, disciple of Rabbainu — how to proceed regarding Rosh HaShanah, since he needed to travel to Uman yet a mourner during the seven days is forbidden to leave his home. The rabbi replied that with such a question he should go to Reb Nachman Pessachles [who was one of the greatest disciples of Moharan'as — a fiery, passionate servant of G-d of immeasurable greatness, who brought young men close to the service of G-d with complete self-sacrifice]. When he came to Reb Nachman with the question, he answered: "The Shulchan Aruch rules that a mourner in a case of davar ha'avud [an irretrievable loss — if he does not act, the loss cannot be recovered] is permitted to travel. And where is there a greater davar ha'avud than not being in Uman for Rosh HaShanah?!" "Un viya iz do a greser davar ha'avud fun nit tsi zayn in Uman af Rosh HaShanah?!"
